about: Advanced Mechanical Essence's mix (#209): every item at band intermediate 2 or deeper that carries copper, iron, gold or redstone, under the rules in advanced-mix.md. lvl = recycles to reach refined; full = metal at full amounts; t1 = per item at tier 1, each recycle 0.25, storage blocks recycled; t1craft where present = storage blocks crafted back to ingots.
